introduction: Use the same route to transport an object. Picking up, carrying and placing a beeper makes command order part of the result.
explanation: pickBeeper(); transfers one beeper from Karel’s current square into its bag. putBeeper(); transfers one from the bag onto the current square. Neither command moves Karel. Picking up requires a beeper on the square; putting down requires one in the bag.
objective: Collect the beeper at (2, 1), carry it through the corridor, and put it down at (5, 4). Finish there facing north with an empty bag.
instruction: Start at (1, 1) with an empty bag. Follow the corridor using one left turn at (5, 1). The destination starts empty: deliver the only beeper there.

commands.description: Take one beeper from this square.
Place one beeper on this square.

hints: First move onto the square with the beeper. Pick it up before continuing down the corridor.
Carry it to the corner, turn left once, and follow the right-hand corridor to street 4. Moving does not change the bag’s contents.
After move(); and pickBeeper();, three more moves reach the corner. Turn left, move three times, then use putBeeper();.

illustration.alt: Two before-and-after pairs show gold coin beepers. pickBeeper(); removes the coin from Karel’s square and changes Bag: 0 to Bag: 1. putBeeper(); places the coin on the square and changes Bag: 1 to Bag: 0. Karel does not move or turn.
illustration.caption: One coin is one beeper. Pick up here, carry it, put it down there.

title: Beeper delivery
